name: Instagram Jewelry Store FAQ Assistant
description: Replies to common jewelry-store questions about materials, availability, delivery, care instructions, and human support without inventing product facts.

steps.description: Receive a customer direct message through the official Instagram messaging integration.
Match the message to an approved FAQ category without guessing missing product information.
Read the approved answer and any current product availability from the configured source.
Send the verified response or transfer the conversation to a person when confidence is low.

privacy.notes: Do not include access tokens in the workflow and avoid storing message content unless the business has a documented retention policy.

testing: Ask a question that has an approved FAQ answer and confirm the exact answer is returned.
Ask about an unknown product and confirm the assistant escalates instead of inventing details.
Send a message containing personal information and verify it is not written to logs by default.
